summary: Frontend-only UI test of FASE 2 (unified Lead tab inside Lead Finder + Converti in Lead + duplicate detection) as superadmin at /marketing/organizzatori. Verified: (1) new lf-tab-leads tab appears between Dashboard and Organizzatori. (2) Clicking lf-tab-leads renders the embedded Leads component (data-testid leads-page) with the exact 6 columns Nome | Organizzazione | Email | Origine | Data | Stato and Origine badges are rendered (Demo sito, Lead Finder, Inserimento manuale). (3) Converti in Lead on an organizer creates a lead with Origine=Lead Finder (toast 'Convertito in Lead'). (4) FASE 1 modals (lf-edit-modal, lf-delete-modal, lf-bulk-delete-modal) now include <DialogDescription> — no Radix a11y warning observed in the console. CRITICAL: the duplicate-detection modal (data-testid lf-convert-dup-modal) and its 'Collega al Lead esistente' button (data-testid lf-convert-link-btn) are declared in the acceptance criteria but are NOT rendered anywhere in /app/frontend/src/pages/LeadFinder.jsx. State `convDup` is set via setConvDup() at line 103 but no JSX consumes it, so on re-convert nothing happens visually (no modal, no toast) — user is stuck.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate detection modal is missing from JSX. State `convDup` is set (line 103) but there is no <Dialog> with data-testid="lf-convert-dup-modal" nor any button data-testid="lf-convert-link-btn". Re-converting the same organizer produces no visible feedback (no modal, no toast). Backend correctly returns duplicate=true but the UI silently swallows it.

integration_issues.issue: On 2nd click of lf-convert-lead-btn for the same organizer, no UI change happens. Expected: dup modal 'Contatto già presente' with link button; on confirm toast 'Collegato al Lead esistente'. Actual: nothing (state set but no render).

action_items: Add the missing duplicate-detection <Dialog> in /app/frontend/src/pages/LeadFinder.jsx: render when `convDup` is set, with data-testid="lf-convert-dup-modal", DialogTitle 'Contatto già presente', a 'Collega al Lead esistente' Button (data-testid="lf-convert-link-btn") that calls convertToLead(convDup.org, true), and a Cancel button that setConvDup(null). Include a <DialogDescription> to avoid Radix a11y warning.

critical_code_review_comments: LeadFinder.jsx: `convDup` is orphan state — set but never consumed by JSX. This is a P0 acceptance-criteria miss for FASE 2.
convertToLead sets convDup with `{oid, org, ...data}` but on force-link path resets to null without any UI in between. The modal must be added before the fix is complete.
POST /api/leads endpoint requires Italian field names (nome, cognome/organizzazione, privacy_accepted). If future tests need to seed leads programmatically, document this in test_credentials/README.
Consider extracting FASE 2 duplicate modal into its own subcomponent alongside the (soon to grow) LeadFinder.jsx (already >650 lines).

rca of the issue: convertToLead in LeadFinder.jsx correctly calls setConvDup on duplicate=true but there is no Dialog JSX that reads `convDup` and renders 'Contatto già presente' + 'Collega al Lead esistente'. Reproduction: (1) create org, (2) open detail, (3) click lf-convert-lead-btn — first time creates the lead; (4) reopen detail, click lf-convert-lead-btn again — backend returns 200 with duplicate=true, frontend sets state but nothing appears. Mitigation: add a <Dialog open={!!convDup} onOpenChange={(o)=>!o && setConvDup(null)}> block with the required test-ids and wire the link button to convertToLead(convDup.org, true).
